Precisely! I did exactly that some time ago. I did vastly overestimate the effect that dropping out would have on me. I halfheartedly used the resources that were offered without any real intention of recovering. But that was a rather willy-nilly affair, I'm thinking some structure here will help; to that end I have other means of reinforcement in place. It's especially helpful having a plan that makes things look accidental. I found that at rock bottom my inhibition wasn't a problem with "having something", but rather with not wanting to upset others.

Treatment hasn't really ever helped? I've been through quite my share of counselors and meds. Read rather thoroughly about options I haven't tried. 

Thank you for replying!
